title: UI风格#21 - Kawaii Pastel (可爱粉彩)
description: 创建第21种UI风格：可爱粉彩风格 - 柔和粉彩、圆润造型、糖果元素。输出到 G:/claude_code_project/web/index_planU.html

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Kawaii Pastel style When color palette Then features soft pastels with white, pink, mint, lavender
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 需要设计：#FFB5C5 (粉), #B5EAD7 (薄荷), #E0BBE4 (薰衣草), #FFDFD3 (蜜桃), #FFFFFF (白)

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Kawaii Pastel style When typography Then uses rounded fonts: Quicksand, Nunito, or Comfortaa
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 字体选择：Quicksand (显示), Nunito (正文), Comfortaa (替代)

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Kawaii Pastel style When layout Then soft cards, pastel backgrounds, rounded corners everywhere
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 布局特点：柔和卡片、粉彩背景、圆润边角、糖果装饰

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Kawaii Pastel style When UI elements Then kawaii faces, soft shadows, bouncy animations
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 交互特点：可爱表情符号、柔和阴影、弹跳动画、hover发光

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Kawaii Pastel UI When functional Then includes cute chat, pastel agents, candy stats
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 功能需求：可爱聊天界面、粉彩代理、糖果统计

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Kawaii Pastel UI When copy Then uses kawaii language: 'Cute', 'Sweet', 'Sparkle', 'Dreamy'
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 创意文案：标题'SWEET. CUTE. SPARKLE.'、按钮'SEND'→'HEARTS'、'SUBMIT'→'MAGIC'
